summary: Marquee text ribbon end-to-end verification. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass covering public spec, per-app resolve, PUT validation ranges, text 160-char cap, reset, and template/site payloads. Frontend: verified landing page (both ribbons, outline-only text, hover slowdown from 34s->113.3s), template gallery FullPreview modal on saas (dark, purple stroke) and dental (light, blue thicker stroke, data-marquee-mode='light'), Site Mode editor panel with all controls, client public site /p/{token} shows ribbons when enabled and hides when disabled.

integration_issues.issue: Text input onBlur save() and enabled-toggle save() can race: the full-payload onBlur PUT may overwrite an in-flight toggle PUT because save() is not sequenced/debounced and both fire independently. In manual UI stress test the toggle click did not persist (backend still enabled=true) when done immediately after a text edit's onBlur. Purely a UX/robustness issue; each control works fine when used in isolation and via backend PUT directly.

action_items: (Nit, optional) In MarqueeEditor, debounce/serialize saves or await pending save before firing a new one, so rapid text-blur + toggle interactions can't clobber each other.
critical_code_review_comments: MarqueeEditor.save() with no arg sends the whole current state — a stale field (e.g. speed changed only via keyboard slider without React state update) will be overwritten by whatever is in `d`. Consider sending only the changed field.
PublicPreview correctly gates on mq.enabled === false — good. TemplateGallery FullPreview always renders regardless of mq.enabled (fine because the preview is a designer surface).
MarqueeRibbon uses `mode === 'light'` correctly and its stroke width differs between light (1.6px) and dark (1.2px) — matches design intent.
seed_data_creation: None. Test data written to app_testlab marquee was reset via POST /apps/app_testlab/marquee/reset at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Marquee ribbons render in all three surfaces: landing (/), template preview modal (/templates → click card → FullPreview), and public client site (/p/{preview_token}). The route for the public client site is /p/{token} (NOT /preview/{token} which is the landing). App tabs on /apps/{app_id} use data-testid tab-<key>-btn where <key>='builder' opens Site Mode where MarqueeEditor lives. Master workspace app_testlab preview token: pv_c3b797fcdafc58d4e70e320f. Backend endpoints all under /api prefix, cookie-based auth (POST /api/auth/login with email/password sets HttpOnly cookie).
